description: Comment “Director” and I’ll send you the link 👇 We’ve officially hit the point where AI can generate 5-minute cinematic videos that look so good you can’t even tell they’re AI. openart_ai just launched a brand new tool called Director, and it’s pioneering a whole new category called Vibe Directing. The idea? Generate entire cinematic videos just by talking to the AI. It handles the whole creative process from start to finish. Here’s how it works: Go to OpenArt and choose Director Type in anything you want. I said “Create a cinematic short film” Watch it build the entire thing The craziest part? It generates the whole thing in one piece, up to 5 minutes long, without stitching clips together. It also has narrative intelligence, so you get proper story arcs, character development, and scene pacing that actually looks good. And the characters stay consistent, same face, same voice from start to finish, which is the one thing every other AI tool gets wrong. If you make any kind of video content and want to become a Vibe Director yourself, comment “Director” and I’ll send you a link to try it on OpenArt. #ai #aitools #openartpartner #director #aivideo
